impression.title: What a Korean hears in your name.
impression.sub: Not what it means — what it sounds like. Five things a Korean ear picks up before it thinks about anything else.
impression.label: A Korean name
impression.hint: Write it in Latin letters or in Hangul. A family name is optional; we read the given name.
impression.waiting: Write a name above and we will read it back to you.
impression.not_korean: That reads as a foreign name rather than a Korean one, so there is nothing here for a Korean ear to pick up. Try a Korean name — Hajun, Seoyeon, or Kim Minseo.
impression.disclaimer: This reads sound, not fortune. It counts the consonants and vowels your name is built from and how often Koreans use them — nothing about the person carrying it.
impression.family_note: Read as the family name — family names are inherited, so this one sits out of the scoring.

blend.friendly_refined: Easy to say and easy to trust — the name of someone who gets introduced to everyone and remembered by all of them.
blend.friendly_cute: Warm and light. This is a name people shorten into a nickname within a week of meeting you.
blend.friendly_calm: Unhurried and open. It sounds like the person everyone ends up telling things to.
blend.friendly_uncommon: Familiar sounds in an arrangement nobody expects — approachable, but not one of a crowd.
blend.refined_cute: Polished with something soft underneath. It reads younger than it sounds serious.
blend.refined_calm: The quiet, well-made kind of name. Nothing about it is trying.
blend.refined_uncommon: Elegant and rare at once — the sort of name people ask you to repeat, then compliment.
blend.cute_calm: Gentle all the way through. Soft sounds, no sharp edges, nothing raised.
blend.cute_uncommon: Playful and unplaceable. Koreans will smile at it before they work out where it is from.
blend.calm_uncommon: Still and slightly out of time — a name that sounds like it has been somewhere.

pair.title: Hợp tên
pair.sub: Nhập hai cái tên để xem mức độ hợp nhau. Kết quả được tính từ số nét của chữ Hangul, theo phương pháp truyền thống Hàn Quốc.
pair.hint: Tên viết bằng chữ Latinh sẽ được đọc sang Hangul. Bạn có thể tự nhập Hangul để sửa.
pair.waiting: Nhập cả hai tên để xem kết quả.
pair.disclaimer:
Đây là một trò chơi truyền thống, không phải chuyện xem vận. Nó chỉ đếm số nét Hangul.
Nhập hai tên theo thứ tự ngược lại sẽ cho kết quả khác.
pair.no_name_desc: Trả lời bốn câu hỏi để nhận một cái tên, rồi quay lại đây.
